meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 首次上手 omo 时,它会按顺序带你走六条通道:功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值估算、记忆记录,以及首次会话的 init-deep 建议。它用你的语言回应,并随时把了解到的你记进记忆。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用 omo 时首次自动启动,该自动启动一生只发生一次;之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动唤起。

say.text: 我是新用户,带我上手 omo
say.note: 启动六条通道的首次引导

say.text: 帮我从 Claude Code 迁移过来
say.note: 进入迁移通道,读取旧配置并给出方案,等你同意才动手

say.text: 看看我以前那些会话,算算能省多少
say.note: 先做会话考古,再据此做价值估算

howto.what_en: On a first run it guides a new omo user through six lanes in order, from a feature tour to a first-session init-deep proposal, replying in the user's language and recording durable facts as it goes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. Auto-start happens only once ever; afterwards the user can bring it back with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I'm new — walk me through omo
Help me migrate from Claude Code
say_en.note: Opens the migration lane and drafts a plan for approval

say_en.text: Look at my past sessions and estimate the savings
say_en.note: Runs session archaeology, then value mapping
